What is the plot of "Blade Runner 2099"?

Cora and Olwen set out in pursuit of a runaway, but on the job they "they uncover a truth threatening to destroy their fragile city".

We know that Cora isn't being entirely truthful to her commanding Blade Runner, but after a frosty, hostile introduction, it appears that there's more than meets the eye to Olwen too.

With plot points thin on the ground ahead of the limited series' premiere, we're expecting this cat-and-mouse dynamic to crank up the tension while uncovering unlikely common ground between the two parties.

Are there any "Blade Runner 2099" teasers and trailers?

There are multiple "Blade Runner 2099" trailers, each of which delight in flaunting the production design that helped launch Ridley Scott's 1982 blockbuster to cult classic status.

We're still getting cars flying through moody, industrial city-scapes and skyscraper-sized billboards, but it seems the magnificent trenchcoats, as sported by Harrison Ford's Rick Deckard and Rutger Hauer's Roy Batty, are out.
